## A bit of history

The history of `ebd.csic.es` domain is deeply intertwined with the birth of the
Spanish internet itself, and the dates are remarkably precise. The `.es`
country-code top-level domain was established by [IANA](https://www.iana.org/)
on **February 14, 1988**, and immediately delegated to *Centro de Comunicaciones
CSIC-RedIRIS* (ES-NIC). This makes the `.es` domain one of the earliest European
ccTLDs, and crucially, [**CSIC**](www.csic.es) **was its very first manager** —
meaning `csic.es` and its subdomains like `ebd.csic.es` were effectively native
to the system from day one. By late 1988 I was already somehow familiar with
html and started designing a website using
[Mosaic](https://www.ncsa.illinois.edu/research/project-highlights/ncsa-mosaic/)
(and later [Netscape
Communications](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Netscape_(web_browser))).

Although `.es` was created in 1988, actual domain registrations came slowly. The
very first registration was `nic.es` in **1990**, created by RedIRIS itself. The
first external institution still active today is `iac.es` (Instituto de
Astrofísica de Canarias), registered in **1991**. During this period
registrations were free of charge, assigned on a first-come-first-served basis,
and exclusively for academic and research institutions. Since CSIC was the
administrative body running ES-NIC, `csic.es` and all its institute subdomains —
including `ebd.csic.es` — were almost certainly among the very earliest
registrations, likely **1990–1991**.

The hostname `ebd10.ebd.csic.es` follows the classic early-1990s convention of
naming machines sequentially within an institution's subdomain. In this scheme
`ebd.csic.es` was [EBD's](https://www.ebd.csic.es) institutional zone, and
`ebd10` was a specific physical machine (actually a small Apple Mac IIci) that I
used to serve as the first web/FTP server. That was an ubiquitous naming pattern
in RedIRIS-connected institutions between **1990 and 1995**.

This is a brief summary table of the temporal progression:

| Year | Event |
|:---------------------------------------|:---------------------------------------|
| Feb 1988 | `.es` ccTLD created; delegated to CSIC/RedIRIS |
| mid-late 1988 | I started developing the website and started serving the site by March 1989 (still no TCP/IP) |
| 1990 | First `.es` registration (`nic.es`); Spain's first TCP/IP internet link |
| 1991 | First external `.es` domain (`iac.es`); `ebd.csic.es` likely registered |
| 1994 | CSIC formally takes over RedIRIS management |
| 1995 | Commercial demand for `.es` explodes; academic monopoly ends |
| Aug 1996 | Formal paid registration rules introduced; RedIRIS separates registry from services |
| 2000 | Spanish Ministry of Industry takes `.es` management from RedIRIS; RED.ES created |

As a domain `ebd.csic.es` has existed since approximately **late 1990–early
1991**, and `ebd10.ebd.csic.es` as a hostname has been in DNS since the late to
mid-1990s. The oldest Wayback Machine snapshot of the actual website is in
[WebArchive](https://web.archive.org/web/*/http://ebd10.ebd.csic.es/). Here is a
visual summary.
